_doc: Dated programme updates (newest first after sorting). Only real events with a source. 'kind' is clinical | operational | funding | publication.

updates.title: Phase 1 analysis outputs delivered
updates.body: The statistical and pharmacokinetic analysis outputs for the Phase 1 study were delivered. A results summary will be published after review.

updates.title: Phase 1 database locked
updates.body: The Phase 1 study database was locked so that the final analysis could begin.

updates.title: Phase 1 study completed
updates.body: The last study activity took place in the Phase 1 study of NWPT-SM32300 in 14 healthy volunteers.

updates.title: Phase 1 study started
updates.body: The first healthy volunteers gave consent to take part in the UK Phase 1 study (NCT07186283), which compared single doses of NWPT-SM32300 with the licensed cannabidiol medicine Epidyolex.
